---
title: Research tools lab
---

## What the labs are for

The labs will help students use LLM-agent tools in economic research, alongside Git and other conventional research tools. The emphasis is on planning a research task, using tools effectively, checking results, and keeping work reproducible.

Python supports the computational work throughout the labs.

## Before the first lab

Setup instructions and tool requirements will be announced before the first lab.

## Weekly structure

Each week's lab will specify the research task, the tools and workflow, an in-class activity, and the expected deliverable. Each weekly page also reserves separate homework reading and exercise sections.

## Optional background

Students who need Python background can consult @quantecon-python and @coding-economists. Any optional programming exercises will be linked from the relevant weekly page when available.
